name: Web Fundamentals
description: Core browser and web platform knowledge: semantic HTML, DOM API, browser rendering pipeline, forms and validation, responsive design, accessibility, HTTP protocol, browser storage mechanisms, modern Web APIs, and progressive web app concepts.

subskills.name: Semantic HTML
subskills.description: Proper use of HTML5 semantic elements (header, nav, main, article, section, aside, figure) for document structure and machine readability.

subskills.name: DOM Manipulation
subskills.description: DOM API traversal, node creation, event listeners, and programmatic DOM updates.

subskills.name: Browser Rendering Pipeline
subskills.description: Critical rendering path, CSSOM construction, layout/reflow, paint, compositing layers.

subskills.name: Forms & Validation
subskills.description: HTML form elements, native constraint validation API, input types, FormData.

subskills.name: Responsive Design
subskills.description: Mobile-first approach, viewport meta tag, media queries, fluid layouts.

subskills.name: Web Accessibility (a11y)
subskills.description: WCAG guidelines, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, focus management.

subskills.name: HTTP Protocol
subskills.description: HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 multiplexing vs HTTP/3 QUIC, status codes, headers, request methods.

subskills.name: Browser Storage
subskills.description: localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookies — storage quotas, eviction policies, and appropriate use cases.

subskills.name: Modern Web APIs
subskills.description: Intersection Observer, Mutation Observer, ResizeObserver, Web Workers, Service Workers, Fetch/AbortController.

subskills.name: Progressive Web Apps
subskills.description: Web App Manifest, service worker lifecycle, offline-first strategies, installability criteria.

github.signal: Semantic HTML5 elements in component templates
DOM manipulation API usage in JavaScript files
ARIA attributes in templates or JSX
Service Worker or PWA manifest file
Responsive viewport meta and media queries in CSS
HTTP client configuration or caching headers

cv.signal: Responsive web design and cross-browser development

linkedin.signal: HTML5, Responsive Design, or Web Accessibility endorsed
Progressive Web Apps or Service Workers endorsed

junior.description: Writes semantic HTML, handles DOM events, builds validated forms, and implements mobile-first responsive layouts.

mid.description: Understands the rendering pipeline for performance optimization, ensures WCAG compliance, and leverages HTTP/2 features.

senior.description: Architects offline-capable PWAs, selects appropriate storage strategies, and leverages advanced browser APIs for complex interactions.
